newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon positive on airlines.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon positive on airlines.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it remains postive on airline stocks and expects third quarter earnings to show improvement in operating and net income due to solid fundamentals.
-- said it expects earnings for 1997 will surpass last year, while 1998 will be even better than 1997.
-- said capacity remains under control, while traffic has grown.
-- said airline management now emphasizes earnings instead of marketshare.
-- said noise regulations will restrict capacity additions and upcoming emissions standards will further restrict capacity.
-- said the use of the Internet will reduce distribution costs and add revenue due to last minute seat sales.
-- said is positive on industry and recommends US Airways Group Inc, AMR Corp, America West Holdings Corp, Delta Air Lines Inc, Northwest Airlines Corp, Southwest Airlines Co and UAL Corp.
